title: 1620 Prairie's door hood, from the 1874 engraving
items: 1620 Prairie's front door now stands under the hood the 1874 engraving draws: a painted timber hood on a carved bracket at each end, with a row of small brackets under its cornice, in the same joinery as the bay window's hood beside it.
Its flat top is railed on three sides under the window above, so it doubles as a small balcony.
How far it projects and its bracket and railing sizes are a reconstruction; the engraving gives its height, width and the rail on top.
